explanation: IntToString extracts decimal remainders, appends a sign when needed and reverses the characters. StringToInt accumulates decimal digits using multiply-add and applies the supplied sign. The wrapper checks both conversions.
timeComplexity: O(d) time for d decimal digits.
spaceComplexity: O(d) returned-string space and O(1) further arithmetic workspace.
